issues.title: NG9-3 B207 alternator A0047 is not an original 9-5 B235 A0319 replacement
issues.cause: Different AS-PL catalogued alternator products have 5 versus 6 pulley grooves, 120A versus 130A, and plugs PL_2200 versus PL_9105.
symptoms: Generic Saab turbo alternator offered without correct part number
issues.diagnosis_summary: Match original installed stamping, Saab VIN application, charging-system regulator and pulley/connector.
issues.correction_summary: Do not recommend a cross-model alternator interchange without manufacturer fitment and testing.
limits: No actual exchange or reliability test.
